definitions.explanation: Additional classes or study sessions to help students catch up or improve, often held outside regular school hours.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夏休|なつやす}み→夏休み：02925_natsuyasumi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{補習|ほしゅう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There are supplementary lessons during summer vacation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{成績|せいせき}→成績：03379_seiseki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で{補習|ほしゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧ことになった。
examples.english: Because my grades were bad, I have to take remedial classes.

examples.japanese: ⟦{放課後|ほうかご}→放課後：12720_houkago⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{補習|ほしゅう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{数学|すうがく}→数学：01442_suugaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{復習|ふくしゅう}→復習：01718_fukushuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I reviewed math in the after-school supplementary class.

notes:
{補習|ほしゅう} refers to extra classes, often for students who need additional help.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {補習|ほしゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧: to take supplementary lessons
- {補習|ほしゅう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: there are supplementary lessons
- {補習|ほしゅう}⟦{授業|じゅぎょう}→授業：00781_jugyou⟧: supplementary class

USAGE:
{補習|ほしゅう} often implies remedial study for struggling students, though it can also refer to optional extra study sessions. Compare with ⟦{補講|ほこう}→補講：09973_hokou⟧, which usually refers to make-up classes for missed sessions.
